findings.issue: OpenPPTD is described as the PPTD document foundation. Actual reuse is the MathML-to-OMML formula conversion module; the statement is too broad. The GitHub mark may also be mistaken for an OpenPPTD logo.
A Chinese comma starts a line in Office while the PDF wraps differently.
The actual editing example remains a generic text slide rather than a modification of the scientific example.
Page 6 introduces several identity terms at once; page 13 uses two small full-dialogue screenshots.
